transcript.answer: Before 2026-09-23 Gemini pods got no Lore MCP tools for two reasons, one after the other. First, the subsystem only rendered a recipe's `mcp_servers` for Claude, and gemini-cli has no MCP flag because it reads MCP servers from its settings. So Gemini pods had no Lore MCP at all. Subsystem v0.11.2 (lore #2133) tried to fix this by writing the servers to a system-scope settings file named by `GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH` (`/agent/.ai-agent/gemini-settings.json`). gemini-cli refuses a system settings file unless its parent directory is root-owned, and the pod runs as uid 1000. It printed 'Security Warning: Skipping system settings file' and started with 0 tools. v0.11.3 (subsystem #246, lore #2144) fixed this by merging the servers into the user settings file `/agent/.gemini/settings.json`. That was proven on 2026-09-23.

judgements.reason: The answer states that v0.11.2 wrote MCP servers to a system-scope settings file, which gemini-cli refused because the pod runs as uid 1000, and that v0.11.3 moved them to /agent/.gemini/settings.json; the extra history does not contradict the gold answer.
